title: Graphic Designer cum Video Editor
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a talented Creative Designer to bring the ibaby brand to life visually — across social media, in\-store displays, packaging inserts, digital ads, and our e\-commerce website. You will work closely with the Content Head to produce design and video content that is warm, premium, and speaks directly to new and expecting parents.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* 1–3 years of experience in design and video content creation, in a brand, agency, or retail setting
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Adobe Premiere Pro/After Effects (basic motion graphics)
* Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating clean, professional design and engaging video edits across digital and print
* Good understanding of brand identity, visual communication, and storytelling principles
* Ability to work within brand guidelines and ensure consistency across formats
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Experience designing or editing for baby, parenting, or premium lifestyle brands
* Familiarity with Canva or CapCut for quick\-turnaround social content
* Knowledge of Figma or similar UI/UX tools

title: Product Design Associate (UI/UX)
description:
**Job Title: Product Design Associate (UI/UX)**

**Company Overview:**

Airveda is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to helping people breathe well and live well. We specialize in building comprehensive Air Quality Monitoring IoT systems for both indoor and outdoor environments. Our mission is to empower individuals to manage their air pollution exposure while creating awareness about the importance of air quality. In addition, we collaborate with schools, offices, and other institutions to provide healthier environments for their occupants.

**Location: Gurugram**  
**Working Mode: Full\-time, Work from Office.** 

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Product Designer (UI/UX)** to join our growing team. This role is ideal for a **fresher or early\-career designer** with internship experience who is passionate about creating intuitive, user\-centric digital experiences.

As a Product Designer, you will work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to design engaging interfaces for our website, dashboard, mobile apps as well as contribute to our hardware products. You should have a strong eye for aesthetics, usability, and modern design principles, along with the ability to turn ideas into functional, seamless user experiences.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a strong career in product design within a fast\-paced and collaborative environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design intuitive, visually appealing, and user\-friendly interfaces for websites, landing pages, dashboards, mobile apps and consumer hardware products.
* Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs based on business and user requirements.
* Work closely with developers to ensure smooth design implementation and consistency across products.
* Conduct user research, competitor analysis, and usability testing to improve product experiences.
* Build and maintain design systems, UI components, and style guides for brand consistency.
* Translate complex workflows into simple, engaging, and easy\-to\-use interfaces.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, engineering, and marketing.
* Stay updated with current UI/UX trends, design tools, and emerging technologies.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Fine Arts, Computer Applications, Human\-Computer Interaction, or related field (preferred but not mandatory with strong portfolio).
* **0–2 years of experience** (internships/projects included) in UI/UX or Product Design.
* Proficiency in design tools such as **Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator**, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of **responsive design, design systems, accessibility, and user\-centered design principles**.
* Understanding of **HTML/CSS basics** will be an added advantage.
* Strong portfolio showcasing UI design, UX thinking, case studies, or live projects.
* Good communication skills and ability to receive/implement feedback effectively.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with attention to detail.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Passion for designing products that users love.
* Strong visual design sense with clean and modern aesthetics.
* Curiosity to understand user behavior and solve design problems.
* Ability to learn quickly and work in a collaborative environment.
* Ownership mindset and willingness to experiment with ideas.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to work on meaningful digital products with real impact.
* Collaborative work culture with exposure to product thinking and execution.
* Fast learning environment with mentorship and growth opportunities.
* Chance to build a strong portfolio through live projects.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
